deadline.value: December 15 (only complete applications by then get full consideration); year inferred
deadline.quote: Our application deadline is December 15. | Only completed applications submitted by the December 15 deadline are given full consideration.

fee_waiver.value: Only a one-time partial waiver, for hardship (international eligibility not addressed); submit the application first, then email lindacase@pas.rochester.edu
fee_waiver.quote: If the application fee of $70 is a hardship, a one-time partial fee waiver may be available. You must first create your application account through apply.grad.rochester.edu, complete AND submit your application, then you may email lindacase@pas.rochester.edu.

gre_general.value: Accepted but not required; self-report in the application
gre_general.quote: General GRE test scores, as well as the Physics GRE subject test scores, are accepted, but not required.

gre_physics.value: Accepted but not required; self-report in the application
gre_physics.quote: General GRE test scores, as well as the Physics GRE subject test scores, are accepted, but not required.

toefl_min.value: No minimum TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo score; scores read in context. TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo accepted.
toefl_min.quote: We do not have minimum required scores for the GRE, GRE Physics, TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo.

english_waiver.value: Waived only for citizens of listed English-native countries or after 3+ years of full-time in-person study in those countries or the US; India is not on the list
english_waiver.quote: The English proficiency test requirement is waived for citizens of the following countries whose native language is English: | Australia Canada Commonwealth Caribbean Nations Ghana Ireland Kenya Liberia New Zealand Nigeria Singapore South Africa Uganda United Kingdom Virgin Islands | The requirement may also be waived if a student has completed at least three years of full time and in-person postsecondary study in one of the countries listed above or the United States.

supervisor.value: Students find a thesis advisor after entering the program; there is no formal assignment process
supervisor.quote: As soon as possible, graduate students should become familiar with the research programs available in the department, choose a field of specialization, and ask a faculty member to serve as thesis advisor and principal PhD supervisor. | It is each student's own responsibility to find a thesis advisor.

funding.value: Admitted PhD candidates receive full tuition, stipend and health insurance; internationals considered for the same support
funding.quote: PhD candidates who are admitted will receive a full tuition scholarship, stipend, and health insurance. | International students are considered for the same financial support as domestic students.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's; a 3-year foreign degree needs a WES evaluation showing US 4-year equivalence. An MA is earned en route; no stand-alone master's.
entry_route.quote: If you are applying with a three-year degree from a foreign institution, you will need to provide a WES evaluation stating that the degree you were awarded is equivalent to a US four-year bachelor's degree.

also.quote: As a PhD candidate, you will earn a Master of Arts during your studies, but we do not offer a stand-alone master’s program.

notes: Indian 3-year BSc holders need a WES equivalency evaluation. No minimum GPA or test scores.
